'''Phrae Pwo''', or '''Northeastern Pwo''', is a [[Karen language]] spoken in Phrae, Lampang, and Chiang Rai provinces of [[Thailand]]. It is not intelligible with [[Pwo languages|other varieties of Pwo]], though it is close to [[Northern Pwo language|Northern Pwo]].
